subject: Request: accounting support for promotional credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@luminexa.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Luminexa Billing <billing@luminexa.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accounting treatment for promotional credits & trial extension

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the support on the Proof-of-Concept. Our procurement team asked me to follow up with a quick accounting question so we can close our month. During the pilot we received a promotional credit (internal reference credit code: LX-PROMO-03) and then agreed to a 14-day trial extension last week. The credits were applied to multiple interim invoices, and we need Redwood to issue formal documentation so our AP team can clear the open balances and reconcile against our quarter-end audit.

Can Redwood provide:
- A single credit memo for the full promotional amount ($28,750) that can be applied to open invoices, or alternatively
- Line-item credit memos tied to each invoice (we currently have INV-4432 and INV-4490 outstanding)

Also: which general ledger account will these credits map to on your side? Our auditors require clarity on contra-revenue vs marketing allowance.

We'd prefer the credit memo issued and shared by EOD 4/15 if possible. Attaching an export of the credits as our ledger shows them (Luminexa_credits_export.csv).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Emma Carter
Revenue Operations | Luminexa
attachments: Luminexa_credits_export.csv (csv)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@luminexa.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accounting treatment for promotional credits & trial extension

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear note and the export. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Priyom (Sales Ops) to align on the accounting path and timing.

Quick summary of our proposed approach so everyone is aligned:
1) Redwood issues a single consolidated credit memo for $28,750 referencing LX-PROMO-03;
2) Apply the credit memo to INV-4432 first (oldest), then apply remaining balance to INV-4490; any residual will remain as a credit on account and appear on your next statement;
3) For GL mapping we propose using our contra-revenue account (GLA 61020) unless Finance advises otherwise;
4) We will provide the credit memo PDF, a short memo describing the reason (promotional allowance / trial extension), and an export for your records.

Next steps: Laura — can you confirm the GLA and whether we should instead route this through a marketing allowance? Also attaching a short MAP for timing and signoffs (MAP-Luminexa-20270412.docx). Emma — if that plan works I will target issuance by COB 4/14 so you have it before your 4/15 cutoff.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0199
attachments: MAP-Luminexa-20270412.docx (docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Carter <emma@luminexa.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accounting treatment for promotional credits & trial extension

Thanks for the context. Emma — copied here is our recommended accounting treatment based on the facts you provided. I also attached our standard credit memo template for auditors.

Recommendation (preferred):
- Issue a single consolidated credit memo for $28,750 referencing LX-PROMO-03 and the two impacted invoices (INV-4432, INV-4490). This simplifies reconciliation on both sides.
- Map the credit memo to contra-revenue (GLA 61020). Rationale: the credit reduced the effective transaction price and therefore reduces revenue; this is preferable to treating as a marketing expense unless Luminexa treats promos as a marketing contra on your books.
- Application flow: apply to the oldest invoice first (INV-4432), then to INV-4490; any remaining balance will be posted as credit on the customer account.
- Journal entries: we will generate a credit memo (AR credit) and corresponding contra-revenue journal to keep revenue recognition aligned. If Luminexa requires a refund instead, we need additional approval and it will carry cashflow implications.

Audit support: attach credit_memo_template.pdf and we will also export the internal audit trail showing who approved the promo and the MAP.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm you want the consolidated memo (yes/no) and authorize issuance by 4/14 COB.
- Priyom: prepare the credit memo in our billing system and attach internal approvals (I'll provide GL mapping code).
- Emma: confirm Luminexa's preferred treatment (contra-revenue vs marketing allowance) for your auditor notes.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting | Redwood Inference
attachments: credit_memo_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Carter <emma@luminexa.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accounting treatment for promotional credits & trial extension

Laura/Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround. We confirm Luminexa will treat this as contra-revenue for audit purposes. The consolidated credit memo is preferred.

A couple of small asks:
- Please include our PO number PO-9984 on the credit memo line-item description so our AP system auto-matches;
- Provide the internal approval trail and the MAP so we can attach to our quarter close package;
- Can you confirm the credit memo number before issuing so we can reserve it in our system?

If you can get the memo to us by EOD 4/14 that will be perfect.

Thanks,
Emma Carter
Revenue Operations | Luminexa
